content.value_statement: Teams need current model choices without chasing changing provider catalogs. This skill turns RouterBase catalog checks into routing plans with fallbacks, validation steps, and cost notes.
actual_capabilities: Classifies workloads by modality, constraints, and required model features.
Guides live RouterBase catalog and pricing checks when credentials are available.
Suggests primary and fallback models with validation tests and caveats.
Documents routing decisions in a repeatable table format.
Highlights retry rules for transient errors and nonretryable request failures.
Separates chat, image, video, audio, and embeddings routing considerations.
limitations: It does not guarantee current prices or model availability without a live catalog check.
It does not replace production evaluation against your own prompts and latency targets.
It cannot verify private account settings or smart routing configuration by itself.
It assumes the user provides RouterBase credentials when live API calls are needed.

use_cases.title: Select a chat routing plan
use_cases.description: Choose a primary chat model, fallback model, and validation test for a new assistant.

use_cases.title: Control inference costs
use_cases.description: Compare model options against price ceilings, latency targets, and quality needs before launch.

use_cases.title: Document platform routing
use_cases.description: Create a clear routing table with assumptions, caveats, and checks for production readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starter Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for one chat workload.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a RouterBase primary model and fallback for a chat assistant. Ask for any missing constraints before finalizing the plan.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Cost and Latency
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate comparison for a budget-sensitive feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare RouterBase model options for this workload: [describe workload]. Prioritize latency, price ceiling, context length, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Multimodal Routing
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced routing across different AI modalities.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design RouterBase routing for chat plus [image, video, audio, or embeddings]. Separate endpoints, fallback choices, and feature assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Production Routing Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced launch review for a production system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this RouterBase routing plan for reliability, fallback compatibility, retry rules, cost checks, and missing production validation.

output_examples.input: Need a low-latency chat assistant with tool calls and a tight monthly budget.
output_examples.output: Recommendation includes a fast chat primary, compatible fallback, pricing check status, tool-schema test, and transient-error retry guidance.

output_examples.input: Need image generation fallback across providers.
output_examples.output: Plan separates image endpoint assumptions, asks for quality targets, and lists validation prompts before production use.

output_examples.input: Need a migration note for RouterBase routing decisions.
output_examples.output: Decision table covers use case, primary model, fallback, reason, validation test, and caveats.

best_practices: Query the live RouterBase catalog before final model recommendations.
Validate tool calling, vision, JSON mode, streaming, and context length with real prompts.
Keep fallback models compatible with the same request shape and user experience.
anti_patterns: Treating published model examples as permanent source of truth.
Retrying authentication, policy, validation, or malformed request failures without a configuration fix.
Choosing fallbacks only by price while ignoring modality and feature compatibility.

faq.question: Does this skill call RouterBase automatically?
faq.answer: It provides catalog and pricing commands. The user or agent must have network access and credentials to run them.

faq.question: Can it compare Claude, GPT, and Gemini models?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps compare providers exposed through RouterBase and recommends primary and fallback choices.

faq.question: Does it include current pricing?
faq.answer: It tells you to check live pricing because provider catalogs and prices can change.

faq.question: Is it only for chat models?
faq.answer: No. It covers chat, image, video, audio, and embeddings routing considerations.

faq.question: Does it replace production evaluations?
faq.answer: No. It supplies a plan and validation checklist, but teams should test real workloads.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: The skill report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
